subject: Using the gmp package in glimmer server

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Using the gmp package in glimmer server
parts:
Hello,

 I have an app using the gmp package, but when I try to install this package on glimmer, I get this error:

........
checking for gcc -std=gnu99 option to accept ISO C89... none needed
checking for __gmpz_init in -lgmp... no
configure: error: GNU MP not found, or not 4.1.4 or up, see http://gmplib.org
ERROR: configuration failed for package ‘gmp’

Is there something I can do, or does it require an installation in the server system ?

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Using the gmp package in glimmer server

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Using the gmp package in glimmer server
parts:
Please Shiny team could you confirm this is not possible to install the required library ? Would it be possible on another server ? 

I'm currently making a Shiny app useful for my research in mathematics. I'd like to share it with my mathematician colleagues but they are not R users, so I need to host the app.

messages.author: 9711d30301c32133
messages.subject: Re: Using the gmp package in glimmer server
parts:
You're correct that it would require installation of a separate package on the server. If you were to host the application on another machine using Shiny Server, you would definitely be able to install that package and host your app without problems.

We'll review gmp and see if we feel we could safely install it on the server without causing any stability problems to existing applications. I'll try to get back to you by the end of the day tomorrow!

Jeff

messages.subject: Re: Using the gmp package in glimmer server

After reviewing them, it looks like both of these libraries were safe to install. They've been added to Spark and Glimmer.

GMP went in without a problem and the corresponding R package seems to work fine. Rmpfr had a bit of an issue installing -- hopefully someone more familiar with the Ubuntu+R+mpfr setup can chime in with either an additional library we need to install or a configuration setting that needs to be used when installing the R package.

Jeff
